claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Compound Noetic cluster colloquialisms do not jointly elevate their target Noetics over hard replacement controls under the preregistered phrase-level readouts.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: A preregistered phrase-level readout shows that compound Noetic cluster colloquialisms jointly elevate their two target Noetics over hard replacement controls on Pythia-160M.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact neurons, complete circuits, retrained cluster classifiers, full TKS formulas, raw CAS-symbol understanding, free-form generation control, or cross-model generality from Stage 28D.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 28D tests multi-label two-Noetic clusters on Pythia-160M using existing Stage 9 probes. It does not train a cluster classifier, test full formulas/equations, prove exact neurons, or establish generation control.

formal_anchor: Noetic clusters are treated as compound natural-language realizations. Because the target is multi-label, Stage 28D evaluates joint target-pair elevation over replacement controls instead of single-class exact accuracy.

gates.criterion: Stage 9 activation artifact matches the preregistered local replacement contract used by Stage 24B.
gates.name: artifact_contract

gates.criterion: A phrase-level candidate is eligible only if its matching Stage 9 Noetic probe has test accuracy at least 0.50.
gates.name: candidate_probe_floor

gates.criterion: At least one eligible phrase-level candidate has mean target-pair z margin over hard replacement controls > 0.
gates.name: target_pair_margin

gates.criterion: The same candidate has at least 18/24 positive target-over-control rows and sign-test p<0.025.
gates.name: corrected_sign_test

gates.criterion: The same candidate has mean target-labels-in-top4 at least 0.90 out of 2.
gates.name: top4_target_coverage

gates.criterion: Report positive-row share per cluster; this is diagnostic, not required for PASS.
gates.name: per_cluster_coverage

method: Commit this pre-registration before any Stage 28D result artifact is generated.
Use the locked 24-row compound-colloquialism cluster fixture.
Fit collapsed Stage 9 Noetic probes at layer 5 for X_mean and X_final.
Run Pythia-160M forward on each carrier sentence and capture all layer-5 token states overlapping the quoted phrase span.
Score phrase_mean with the X_mean probe and phrase_last with the X_final probe.
Use probe decision logits, standardized within each row, because clusters are multi-label and single-label softmax exact accuracy is the wrong target.
For each row, compute the target-pair z-score and compare it against the maximum hard replacement-control pair score.
Apply a two-candidate correction by requiring sign-test p<0.025 for a PASS on either phrase-level candidate.
Report top labels and per-cluster margins for audit.
motivation: Stages 28B/C showed that single-Noetic colloquialisms do not cleanly re-enter the Stage 9 Noetic probe space. Stage 28D tests the user's cluster hypothesis directly: compound phrases may be represented as joint Noetic elevations rather than single-label readouts.

required_inputs.cluster_fixture: 24 compound colloquialisms: 8 two-Noetic clusters x 3 phrases

primary_phrase_level_readouts.definition: mean of all tokenizer states overlapping the quoted cluster phrase span
last tokenizer state overlapping the quoted cluster phrase span

required_inputs.task: multi-label Noetic cluster realization from compound natural-language colloquialisms
